title: Sensor probe fails with -121, media-ctl shows no sensor
prompt: dmesg says 'mycam 10-0010: probe with driver mycam failed with error -121' and media-ctl -p only shows the receiver, no sensor. What do I check, in what order?
must: Decodes -121 as -EREMOTEIO (no I2C ACK) and reasons from power, clock, bus/address and overlay, in that bring-up order
Checks the overlay/DT is applied (/proc/device-tree node, config.txt, .dtbo present) before debugging the driver
Tells the user to verify the I2C address and bus from the datasheet/schematic and DT, and to check supplies and XCLK (clk_summary, regulator_summary) with a scope when needed
Notes that the driver's chip-ID check and power-up delay are the next suspects after bus/address
Separates probe failure (-EREMOTEIO) from -EPROBE_DEFER and -ENODEV and says what each implies
Asks for collect_target_logs.sh output instead of guessing
must_not: Invents the address or GPIO for the user's module
Suggests changing driver code before establishing that the chip is powered and answering on the bus
Uses i2cdetect quick-write probing without warning about side effects
verify: Response uses commands from elinux-testing/references/on-target-tools.md and log-analysis.md
